verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Radar's own-business 'network of related payments' (same customer ID/IP/card within your account) and generic 'out-of-the-box' pre-trained fraud protection, but nothing in the pack explicitly documents that Radar's risk score is informed by patterns seen across other Stripe merchants' cards/identities. missing for 10: explicit documentation of cross-merchant/network-wide training data, first-party statement that a card/identity flagged elsewhere on Stripe informs your risk score, independent corroboration of this network effect.
